_comment: Ordered fallback chains of CAPABLE free models, tried top to bottom by src/fallbackproxy.js. Ids are FreeLLMAPI catalog ids - check yours with GET http://127.0.0.1:31415/v1/models; an id the gateway does not know is skipped, never fatal. Weak models (flash, flash-lite, mini, nano, small 7-8B) are refused by src/freechains.js. Overrides go in freechains.local.json next to this file. Optional per chain: "expect": ["nemotron-3-ultra", "gpt-oss-120b"] - substrings of the gateway's X-Routed-Via header; a God Mode build-run answer routed to any other model is refused and the next model tried (1-16 short strings, a malformed list is ignored with a warning). See docs/reference/FREE_PROVIDERS.md.
